title: Galaxies and the Milky Way
text: A galaxy is a massive, gravitationally bound system of stars, stellar remnants, gas, dust, and dark matter. The Milky Way, our home galaxy, is a barred spiral galaxy containing an estimated 100-400 billion stars, including the Sun. It is about 100,000 light-years in diameter. The observable universe contains an estimated hundreds of billions of galaxies.
